income_certificate.primary_proof: Salary Slip or Form 16 from employer
alternative_proofs: Self-declaration affidavit for daily wage or informal workers (Downloadable pro-forma template available)
Ration card copy with annual income entry
Bank account statement showing last 6 months transactions
Agricultural land tax receipt with estimated yield

disability_pension.primary_proof: Medical Board Disability Assessment Certificate (>40% disability)
alternative_proofs: Unique Disability ID (UDID) Card issued by Ministry of Social Justice
banking_proof: Bank passbook front page showing IFSC code and Account number

community_certificate.primary_proof: SSLC / School Leaving Certificate specifying caste and religion
alternative_proofs: Community certificate of father or mother
Gazette notification of religious or caste conversion
